integrity: Analytical finite-dimensional proof with separately reproducible finite spectral and matrix-exponential checks; finite tests are not proof for arbitrary network sizes. No independent scientific audit was performed.
limitations: Finite rank-one bipartite hopping only, nonzero coordinates, no diagonal disorder or recombination; positive dephasing and absorber rates and asymptotic rather than rate-uniform statement. Full-rank interclass hopping can invalidate the dark-space classification. Possible unlocated equivalent literature remains a priority risk.
title: Exact noise-coverage threshold and dark-state projection for rank-one bipartite quantum networks
